title: Wiener's predictor: feedback is the third body
summary: A gun fired at where the plane was misses again and again. Add feedback, observe the error, adjust, fire again, and the system coordinates with a moving, purposeful target without controlling it. The Uber system lacked exactly this arc closing through awareness.

nodes.label: Target Maneuver
nodes.description: Pilot evades deliberately, with statistical regularities

edges.description: A maneuvering target defeats a fixed aim
Larger error produces a larger correction

identifiability_note: Closed measurement loop; removing feedback makes the error persist.
